Industrial Labels

Discover our comprehensive selection of industrial labels engineered to meet the robust demands of diverse applications. Whether it’s for manufacturing, pharma, chemicals, logistics, or any industrial setting, our labels are designed for durability, resilience, and precise information representation. Trust our industrial labels for high-performance solutions in challenging environments.

Industrial Ribbons

Explore our range of industrial ribbons tailored for reliable and high-performance printing in demanding environments. Our industrial ribbons are designed to meet the stringent requirements of various applications, ensuring optimal print quality, durability, and efficiency. Choose our ribbons for consistent and dependable performance in your industrial printing needs.

1. Our Resin Ribbon is suitable for extreme conditions such as asset labelling due to the unique resistance to most solvents including perfumes, oils, fats, etc.
2. Our Wax-Resin Ribbon offer versatility and chemical resistance, making them perfect for use on glossy, coated paper, and synthetics
3. Our Wax Ribbon is a low-cost solution for rough surface printing.
4. Our Wash Care Ribbon sare scratch and heat resistant and gives durable wash care instructions on taffeta and satin.

Our Ribbons also come in a variety of colours to match industries media application needs.

Paper Labels

  • Indian Chromo : Ideal for personal care products, lubricants, household chemicals, and other premium label applications.
  • Avery Paper : Perfect for labels on personal care products, lubricants, household chemicals, and other prime label applications.
  • HighGum Paper : Designed for labels on personal care products, lubricants, household chemicals, and other prime label applications.
  • TT2C Paper : Recommended for barcode labels in inventory tracking, food packaging, general retail labeling, and industrial markets. Perfect for applications requiring excellent thermal transfer printing and vibrant multicolor process work.
  • Direct Thermal : Lightweight and designed for use in dry weighing scales, process tracking, and point-of-sale item information labeling. Ideal for applications like fruit and vegetable weighing scales, hardware, and work-in-process material tracking.
  • Removable : Versatile for general-purpose removable labels.
  • Mirror Coat : Suitable for all printing methods, including Screen, Offset, Flexo, Digital, and used in printing Product Labels, School Labels, etc.
  • Pharma Label : Essential for pharmaceutical products, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements for over-the-counter medications and prescription drugs. Also suitable for products like anti-cavity toothpaste, rubbing alcohol, sunscreen, and hand sanitizer.
  • Piggybag Label : Perfect for applications requiring both primary and secondary labels, such as courier packages, vaccination records, and tracking labels for corrugated boxes.
  • FSC Certified Label : Ideal for labels on personal care products, lubricants, household chemicals, and other premium label applications.
  • Floresect Label : Versatile for applications requiring both primary and secondary labels, like courier packages, vaccination records, and tracking labels for corrugated boxes.
  • Paper Tag : Heavy utility grade paper, perfect for printing hangtags for consumer goods such as clothing and accessories.

Polyester Labels

  • Glossy : Perfect for general-purpose durable applications, rigid containers, promotional labeling, and household chemicals requiring durability and resistance to moisture and chemicals.
  • Matt : Versatile for thermal transfer print applications such as product identification labels, work-in-progress labels, and asset tags.
  • Silver : A cost-effective alternative to metallic foiling, the luster silver gloss enhances label premiumization in the Wine, Spirits & Beverage category. Also suitable for labels on rigid containers for Cosmetics, Toiletries, Food, and Health & Beauty Aid products.
  • Transparent : Primarily used in cosmetics and toiletries, this option offers durability, resistance to moisture and contents overspill, and functional squeezability. Its flexibility makes it especially suitable for substrates like plastic bags, squeezable bottles, and other flexible containers.
  • High Gum : Specifically designed for use on low and medium surface energy material bags, and for product identification labels on drums.
  • Non-Tearable Tag : Synthetic papers provide various functions for printing, packaging, and labeling in industries such as medicines, cosmetics, and food and beverage.
  • Silver/Golden PP Label : A cost-effective alternative to metallic foiling, the luster silver gloss enhances label premiumization in the Wine, Spirits & Beverage category. Also suitable for labels on rigid containers for Cosmetics, Toiletries, Food, and Health & Beauty Aid products.
  • Inject Label : High ink holdout and quick drying make it an excellent choice for clear and dense printed graphics, making it perfect for primary and secondary packaging labels in retail, manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics.

Security Labels

  • Void Labels : Integral to our security stickers lineup, void labels play a crucial role in preventing external packaging or product tampering, ensuring the integrity of your products.
  • Temper Label : Designed to detect and indicate instances of tampering, temper labels provide an added layer of security, assuring the authenticity and safety of your products.
  • Hologram Label : Our holographic labels are not just a means of providing information about the products but also serve as a robust security feature, enhancing the authenticity of your brand. These labels are crafted to offer a sophisticated and visually striking element to your packaging while safeguarding against counterfeiting and unauthorized alterations.

Speciality Labels

  • Durability Label : Engineered for resilience, our durability labels are designed to withstand challenging environments, providing long-lasting performance. Ideal for applications where labels are exposed to harsh conditions, ensuring your information endures without compromise.
  • High Temperature Label : Crafted to excel in extreme heat conditions, our high-temperature labels maintain their integrity and readability even in challenging thermal environments. Perfect for applications where durability and resistance to elevated temperatures are paramount.
